text: Good morning! Would you mind telling me what is on fire at the moment? I have a release call shortly and would like to know whether anything dreadful has come in overnight. Cheers.
Kindly show me the p0 issues, if there are any. I'd rather know now than be surprised in the stand-up, cheers.
Would you mind checking whether we have any critical bugs open right now? I ask because the client is demoing this afternoon and I'd hate for something to be burning.
I wonder if you could kindly tell me what is urgent today? Anything broken in production would be most useful to hear about first, cheers.
Is anything on fire at present, please? I've just got back from lunch and would like a quick overview of the really nasty ones before I dive in.
Would you be so kind as to list the critical issues we currently have? I mean the proper emergencies, not the cosmetic niggles, cheers.
Kindly let me know if there are any p0s outstanding. The on-call rota changes at five and I would like to hand over properly.
Sorry to trouble you, but is anything urgently broken right now? I'd be most grateful for a rundown of the burning issues, cheers.
Would you mind listing all the open issues, please? I'd like to get a general sense of where we stand before planning. Cheers.
Kindly show me everything labelled bug. I am putting together a stability report and would like the full picture, cheers.
Could you kindly list the issues assigned to me? I've rather lost track of what's on my plate this week.
Would you mind showing me the closed issues in the v2.1 milestone? I'd like to write up the release notes and need to see what we actually finished.
Please could you list all the issues that @priya has opened? I'd like to thank her for her thorough reports, cheers.
Kindly pull up the open enhancement issues for me. I'd like to have a look before the planning meeting on Thursday.
Would you be so kind as to show what's assigned to @tom at the moment? I'm concerned he may be overloaded and want to check before adding more.
Might I trouble you for a list of my issues, please? Just the open ones will do nicely, cheers.
Would you mind showing me issue #12, please? I'd like to read the whole thing properly before replying to the reporter, cheers.
Kindly give me the details on #7. I seem to have forgotten what it was about, and I'd rather not guess.
Could you tell me what issue 23 is about, please? Someone mentioned it at lunch and I was too embarrassed to ask.
Would you be so kind as to pull up #31 for me? I need the full description to decide how we proceed, cheers.
Kindly show #4. I'd like to see who commented last and what they said before I weigh in.
Sorry to bother you, but might I see the details of issue #18? The title alone isn't quite enough for me, cheers.
Please would you open up #26 for me and tell me what it says? I want to be sure I have understood the problem correctly.
Would you mind letting me read through #9 in full? I'm preparing a reply and want to be accurate, cheers.
Would you mind filing a new issue titled login button misaligned on safari? I noticed it this morning and would rather it be recorded before I forget, cheers.

Could you please raise a new issue called typo in the readme installation section? It's minor, but it would be lovely to get it fixed, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to create an issue: webhook retries are not backing off? I've been watching the logs and it does look rather worrying.
Kindly file a bug for the dark mode toggle not remembering its state. I'd be most grateful, cheers.
Please open a new ticket titled upgrade the node version in CI. I'd like it on the board before we forget about it entirely.

Sorry to ask, but could you create an issue called add pagination to the api? I'd like to discuss it at the next planning session.
Would you mind labelling #3 as bug, please? I've had a proper look and it is quite clearly a defect, cheers.
Kindly tag #15 with enhancement. It's a feature request, and I'd like it kept separate from the faults.
Could you please add the documentation label to issue 8? The problem is entirely in the wording, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to mark #22 as p0? I'm afraid it is breaking checkout for every customer and needs attention at once.
Kindly apply the needs-triage label to #30. I haven't had time to look at it properly and would like someone to do so.

Sorry to trouble you, but could you tag 19 with security? I'd rather it didn't get lost among the rest.
Would you mind adding the question label to #6? The reporter is really asking for help rather than reporting a fault, cheers.
Would you mind assigning #2 to @priya, please? She knows that module better than anyone and I'd like her to take a look, cheers.
Kindly give #14 to me. I have some free time this afternoon and would like to get it sorted.
Could you please put @tom on #10? He offered kindly to help during the stand-up, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to assign issue 27 to @ana? She's best placed to deal with it, as she wrote the original code.
Kindly assign #5 to @sam. I'd be most grateful if he could have a look this week, cheers.
Please would you hand #33 over to @priya? I'm rather swamped and she was good enough to say she'd take it.
Sorry to ask, but could you assign 21 to me? I'd like to take ownership of it, cheers.
Would you mind putting @ana down as the assignee for #17? I spoke with her earlier and she is happy to do it.
Would you mind commenting on #1 to say that we are looking into it? The reporter has been waiting a while and I'd like to reassure them, cheers.
Kindly reply to #6 saying the fix has been merged into main. Do thank them for their patience, please.
Could you please add a comment to issue 12: can you send over the full stack trace? I'm afraid we can't reproduce it without one.
Would you be so kind as to tell #9 that we are on it? I'd like the reporter to know it hasn't been forgotten, cheers.
Kindly leave a note on #25 saying this will be addressed in the next sprint. Many thanks.

Sorry to trouble you, but could you write on #20 that I'll pick this up tomorrow morning? Cheers.
Would you mind commenting on 35 with thanks for the detailed report? It was genuinely one of the best we have had.
Would you mind closing #6, please? It has been fixed and verified, and I'd like to keep the board tidy, cheers.
Kindly close issue 4. The work is finished and merged, so there's nothing left to do.
Could you please shut #10? It's all done, and I'm most grateful to everyone who helped.
Would you be so kind as to close #28 now that the patch has gone out? Cheers.
This one is resolved, I'm happy to say, so kindly close #13.
Please close 16 for me. We tested it this morning and it works beautifully, cheers.
Sorry to ask, but would you mind marking #38 as closed? The fix is live and I have confirmed it myself.
Kindly wrap up issue 2 by closing it. It's been done for a week and I keep forgetting, cheers.
Would you mind reopening #6, please? I'm afraid the fix did not hold and the problem has come back, cheers.
Kindly bring back issue 4. I closed it too hastily and it is clearly not finished.
Could you please open #10 again? A customer has just reported the same fault, and I'd rather not lose the history.
Would you be so kind as to reopen #29? I made a mistake in closing it, cheers.
Kindly reopen 14. Having tested properly this morning, it is still broken, I'm afraid.
Please reopen issue 7 for me. It turns out the workaround only helped some people, cheers.
Sorry to trouble you, but #36 isn't fixed after all. Would you mind opening it again?
Would you mind undoing the closure of #1? I'd like the team to take another look, cheers.
Would you mind closing the stale issues, please? The backlog has become rather unwieldy and I'd like a clean slate, cheers.
Kindly clean up all the old issues that nobody has touched in ages. Nobody is going to read them, I fear.
Could you please sweep away everything that has gone stale? I'm trying to tidy the board before the quarterly review, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to close all the dormant tickets in one go? I haven't the time to go through them individually.
Kindly archive the stale ones for me. They are cluttering the list and making real problems harder to spot, cheers.
Please tidy up the old issues that have had no activity for months. I'd be most grateful.
Sorry to ask, but could you close everything that has been abandoned for ages? A proper spring clean is long overdue, cheers.
Would you mind doing a stale sweep of the whole repo? Cheers, and thanks for your patience with my many requests.
Would you mind triaging the new issues, please? A good few have come in and I haven't had a chance to look at them, cheers.
Kindly sort out the untagged issues. They are piling up, and I'd like them labelled before the weekend.
Could you please go through whatever has come in and label it? I'm rather behind and would be most grateful.
Would you be so kind as to triage the unlabelled tickets? I'd like to know what we've got before Monday, cheers.
Kindly label the new arrivals for me. I can't bring myself to do it by hand again this week.
Please run a triage over the fresh issues. I'd like each of them to have a proper label, cheers.
Sorry to trouble you, but might you sort the new issues into the right categories? I'd be ever so grateful.
Would you mind tagging everything that has no label yet? Cheers.
Would you mind undoing that, please? I'm afraid I asked for the wrong thing, cheers.
Kindly revert your last action. I think I was a bit hasty and would rather put it back as it was.
Oh dear, no, please take that back. Would you mind undoing it, cheers?
Could you please reverse what you just did? It was not what I intended, and I apologise for the muddle.
Sorry, I'd like to undo that last change, please. I gave you the wrong issue number, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to roll back your previous action? I have changed my mind, cheers.
Kindly cancel that last thing you did. I'm afraid it was a mistake on my part.
Please undo. I realise I should have checked before asking, and I'm sorry for the bother, cheers.
Would you mind rewinding yourself to v3, please? Your recent behaviour has been a bit odd and I'd like the earlier version back, cheers.
Kindly go back to yesterday's brain. I think you learned something unhelpful today and I'd like it forgotten.
Could you please roll your model back to the previous version? Your labelling was much better before, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to forget everything you have learned today? I'd rather start again from the earlier version.
Kindly revert your brain to v2. The newer one is making rather strange guesses, cheers.
Please restore your earlier model, the one from last week. I'd be most grateful.
Sorry to ask, but could you rewind your learning to the state it was in this morning? Something went wrong since then, cheers.
Would you mind going back to an older version of yourself? I preferred how you behaved on Monday, cheers.
Would you mind telling me which brain version you are on, please? I'd like to be sure we're on the latest one, cheers.
Kindly tell me how accurate you are at the moment. I'm curious whether the recent training has helped.
Could you please let me know how many LLM calls you have made so far? I'm keeping an eye on the bill, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to tell me how smart you are today? I'd like an honest figure, cheers.
Kindly report your model version and accuracy. My manager has asked and I'd rather give a proper answer.
Please could you tell me about yourself, in particular which version of the model you are running? Cheers.
Sorry to ask, but how many times have you needed to call an LLM this week? I'd like to know whether you're learning, cheers.
Would you mind telling me how well you are doing? Accuracy and version, if you'd be so kind.
Would you mind telling me what you are able to do, please? I'm new to this and would be most grateful for a quick overview, cheers.
Kindly show me the help. I'd like to know which commands I may use before I embarrass myself.
Could you please explain what you can do for me? I'm not sure where to begin, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to list your commands? I have forgotten how to ask for things properly.
Help, please! I'm afraid I haven't a clue what I'm allowed to ask you, cheers.
Kindly tell me what sort of things you're able to help with. A short list would be lovely.
Sorry to trouble you, but what are your capabilities exactly? I'd like to make good use of you, cheers.
Would you mind giving me a rundown of the commands available? Cheers.
Would you mind removing the bug label from #3, please? On reflection it is a feature request, cheers.
Kindly drop needs-triage from issue 6. I have looked at it properly now, cheers.
Could you please take the p0 label off #9? It is not as urgent as we first thought, and I'd rather not alarm anyone.
Would you be so kind as to untag #14 from enhancement? I applied it by mistake, cheers.
Kindly remove the wontfix label from #21. We've decided to look at it after all.
Please strip the documentation label from 12. It had nothing to do with the docs in the end, cheers.
Sorry to ask, but could you remove the security label from #25? A colleague has confirmed that it is harmless.
Would you mind clearing the question label from #8? The matter has been answered, cheers.
Would you mind unassigning @sam from #2, please? He's been rather busy and I don't wish to burden him, cheers.
Kindly take me off issue 4. I'm afraid I won't have the time after all.
Could you please note that @ana isn't working on #10 any more? She has moved over to the billing project, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to remove @tom from #17? We've reassigned the work, cheers.
Kindly unassign @priya from #22. She is away next week and I'd like someone else to look at it.
Please take me off #19. I appear to have picked it up by accident, cheers.
Sorry to bother you, but @sam is no longer on #31. Would you mind taking his name off?
Would you mind removing the assignee from 7? I'd like it to be open to anyone, cheers.
Would you mind closing #9 as a duplicate of #2, please? They describe exactly the same fault, cheers.
Kindly close issue 5 as a duplicate of 3. I've compared the two and they are clearly one and the same.
Could you please mark #8 as a dupe of #1? The reporter wasn't aware that someone had already raised it, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to close #24 since it is the same as #11? I'd rather keep the discussion in one place.
Kindly treat #33 as a duplicate of #20 and close it, cheers.
Please close 16 as a duplicate. It is the same problem as #12, which already has plenty of discussion, cheers.
Sorry to ask, but could you shut #27, as it's a repeat of #4? I should have spotted it sooner.
Would you mind marking #39 as a dupe of #6 and closing it? Cheers.
Would you mind closing #7 as won't fix, please? We have discussed it at length and the cost simply outweighs the benefit, cheers.
Kindly close issue 5 as not planned. We're not going to be doing it, I'm afraid.
Could you please mark #4 as not planned? I'd like to be honest with the reporter that this isn't on the roadmap, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to close #18 as wontfix? It is working as intended, and I'd rather say so plainly.
Kindly close #26 as not planned. We decided at the meeting that we won't be taking it forward, cheers.
Please shut 34 as won't fix. It's an unusual request and we haven't the capacity, I'm afraid, cheers.
Sorry to trouble you, but we're not doing #13. Would you mind closing it as not planned?
Would you mind declaring #29 a won't fix and closing it? Cheers.
Would you mind checking whether there are any issues about safari, please? I'm sure someone has mentioned it before, cheers.
Kindly search for csv. A customer asked about exporting and I'd like to see if we already have a ticket.
Could you please look for any ticket mentioning webhooks? I'd rather not raise a duplicate, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to find issues that talk about login timeouts? I've a feeling we discussed it ages ago.
Kindly search the issues for oauth. I'd like to see everything that has been said about it, cheers.
Please could you check if anything mentions memory leaks? I've been investigating one and want to compare notes.
Sorry to ask, but is there a ticket about the dark mode flicker? I'd be grateful if you would have a look, cheers.
Would you mind searching for the word pagination in the titles and bodies? Cheers.
Would you mind putting #3 in the v2.1 milestone, please? We would like to ship it with that release, cheers.
Kindly set the milestone for #6 to the march release. I'd like it to be tracked properly.
Could you please move #9 to v2.0? It has to go out with the first batch, cheers.
Would you be so kind as to add issue 14 to the beta milestone? It would be wonderful to have it tracked there.
Kindly place #21 in v3.0. We've agreed that it can wait until then, cheers.
Please attach 30 to the q4 milestone. I'd like to keep my planning board in order, cheers.
Sorry to trouble you, but could you move #12 into the next release milestone? I'd be most grateful.
Would you mind assigning #37 to the v2.1 milestone? Cheers.
Would you mind telling me what the weather is going to be like in Manchester tomorrow? I'm walking to work and rather dread the rain, cheers.
Kindly tell me a joke. It has been a long week and I'd like a laugh, cheers.
Could you please book me a table for two at an Indian restaurant this evening? I'd be most grateful.
Would you be so kind as to recommend a good book on gardening? I've just taken up the hobby and need advice, cheers.
Good morning! How are you getting on today? I do hope the day is treating you kindly.
Kindly work out what 18 percent of 240 is, please. I'm splitting a bill at the pub and cannot do the sum, cheers.
Please could you write me a short poem about the sea? It's my mother's birthday and I'd like to include it in a card.
Sorry to ask something unrelated, but would you mind telling me who won the cricket yesterday? Cheers.
